title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-samira-patel-aaron-li-2026-04-10
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep - Samira Patel (CSM) & Aaron Li (AE)
Date: 2026-04-10
Location: Zoom / Slack huddle
Objective: Align on AtlasPay renewal health, finalize Q3 expansion plan, and agree next steps for two at-risk pilot accounts.

Quick summary / context:
- AtlasPay (Enterprise payments customer) - Renewal due 2026-08-15 (Q3). Currently on Dedicated + Private connectors. ARR: $420k. Primary sponsor (CTO Lina Park) gave positive FYRQ, but Lina is leaving (notice 2026-03-25) which increases churn risk.
- Pilot: FinVault (mid-market) - trial shows strong embeddings usage but latency complaints on peak hours. Potential $90k ARR if converted.
- Pilot: MicroLend (startup) - engineering resource gap; stalled since demo.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick check-in (3 min) - how are you, bandwidth for next 4 weeks
2) AtlasPay renewal status (10 min)
   - Action history: exec sponsor change, recent SRE incident (2026-03-30) resolved, usage + cost trend review
   - Decision needed: propose executive QBR + escalation to Dir-Sales (if Lina exit creates >50% risk)
3) Expansion opportunities (8 min)
   - FinVault: performance SLA promise / proposed discount for SLO guarantee
   - MicroLend: scope minimal integration support to unblock demo
4) Asks from Aaron (5 min) - materials, pricing levers, customer intros
5) Actions and alignment (4 min)

Notes / talking points:
- AtlasPay health signals:
  - Usage: steady token use but a 12% dip in generate API calls last 2 weeks (possible integration fallback).
  - Errors: spike 2026-03-30 due to autoscaling bug; fixed, postmortem linked (JIRA:CS-1028).
  - Cost: Customer requested cost report for top 3 routes; Aaron to provide before 2026-04-14.
  - Exec change: Lina leaving - need to confirm new sponsor. Ask Aaron for intros to VP Product (C-level mapping done in CRM).

- Proposed renewal tactic for AtlasPay:
  1) Schedule executive QBR w/ new sponsor + Dir-Sales & Solutions Eng (goal: re-establish exec alignment) - target date 2026-04-22
  2) Offer a 6-month pilot discount on caching/priority routing (reduce token bill by ~15%) tied to committed throughput
  3) Add a rollback SLA clause and dedicated SRE on-call for 90 days post-renewal to address trust from ops team
  4) Prepare a one-page ROI doc (Samira to draft, Aaron to validate pricing) by 2026-04-16

- FinVault expansion notes:
  - Root cause of latency: peak concurrency >200 req/s causing queueing on their Dedicated pool. Options: increase burst capacity or tune batching.
  - Quick win: propose a 30-day trial of Redwood Optimize batch profile + 10% discount if signed by 2026-05-01.
  - Tech ask: get SE time to run a load test week of 2026-04-20. Aaron to coordinate.

- MicroLend unblock:
  - They need a sample integration skeleton and a 45-min live pairing session.
  - Offer: Solutions Eng office hours slot (2026-04-12) + pre-call checklist. Samira to send invite and checklist by 2026-04-11.

Risks / concerns to surface to Aaron:
- Exec sponsor transitions increase churn risk - flag to sales leadership if we cannot get a stable sponsor by 2026-04-30.
- Support SLOs: recent incident undermines trust; need clear remediation plan and commitment window.
- Budget cycle: AtlasPay final procurement window ends 2026-06-15; if procurement stalls, legal review timelines push into Q4 and reduce renewal probability.

Proposed asks from Aaron (what I need):
- Intros to AtlasPay VP Product and interim technical lead (email thread + context) - due 2026-04-14
- Customer-facing cost breakdown for top 3 routes (CSV) - due 2026-04-14
- SE availability for FinVault load test week 2026-04-20 - confirm by 2026-04-12

Action items (owner - due):
- Samira: Draft AtlasPay 1-pg ROI + remediation plan (2026-04-16)
- Aaron: Provide cost breakdown CSV for AtlasPay routes (2026-04-14)
- Aaron: Intro email to AtlasPay VP Product / interim lead (2026-04-14)
- Samira: Send invite + checklist for MicroLend pairing session (2026-04-11)
- Aaron: Confirm SE load test slot for FinVault (2026-04-12)
- Max Evans: Review proposed 6-month discount language (legal/comms) and give feedback (2026-04-15)

Follow-up cadence:
- Post-1:1 quick sync (Slack) within 48 hours to confirm which actions are in flight
- Weekly renewal deep-dive with Aaron + SEs starting week of 2026-04-20 until AtlasPay contract signed

Open questions / things to decide in the 1:1:
- Do we push for a binding commitment now (short term renewal) vs. wait for new sponsor to settle?
- Can we commit to dedicated on-call SRE for 90 days without Exec sign-off? (Ops constraint)

Reference links and artifacts: confluence:CS-AtlasPay-quarterly-plan, JIRA:CS-1028, github.com/redwood/customer-playbooks/atlaspay-pr

Notes to self (scratch):
- Bring up internal note: consider building a 2-page "Exec renewal playbook" template to speed sponsor transitions (ask PMM/Comms).
- Keep the ask-specific language simple: >"We will assign a dedicated SRE for first 90 days and provide a detailed cost/usage breakdown"

End of doc.
